key_insight: Nesterov’s Accelerated Gradient Descent retains an O(1/T²) convex function-gap rate under relaxed smoothness, with high-probability stochastic guarantees under affine-variance noise.
engineering_relevance: The analysis supports accelerated optimization in machine-learning settings where standard Lipschitz smoothness and bounded-variance noise assumptions may be too restrictive.
method: Analyze deterministic NAG under a generalized smoothness condition.
Establish stochastic convergence bounds under affine-variance noise.
Extend convergence analysis to non-convex objectives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical rates: O(1/T²) with exact gradients and Õ(√(log(1/δ)/T)) with stochastic gradients, improving to Õ(log(1/δ)/T²) for sufficiently small noise parameters.
watch_item: The faster stochastic rate requires sufficiently small noise parameters; the abstract provides no empirical validation or implementation guidance.
paper_title: Convergence Analysis of Nesterov's Accelerated Gradient Descent under Relaxed Assumptions
